thread:
Maria P.: Heads-up — NovaEdge (APAC reseller) just got their marketplace PO rejected. Portal error says EIN mismatch + missing signatory affidavit. They need this cleared today to hit a partner commit window. Anyone available to triage? :exclamation:
Dan F. (Finance): Ugh. Can you attach the raw PO PDF and the partner's billing entity EIN? I can check our mapping and see why the portal flagged it.
Maria P.: PO PDF attached via private link: https://files.redwood/novaedge/po_98765.pdf. Partner EIN in their system: 88-4445556, our marketplace entry shows 88-4445557 (last digit diff).
marketplace-bot: System: PO upload failed — status 409 CONFLICT. Error code: MKT-EIN-MISMATCH. Retry allowed after entity resolution.
Leo K. (Legal): We can draft a signatory affidavit / attestation to accept the mismatch for this PO, but we need proof of signatory authority from NovaEdge (signed PO or scanned signatory letter). Also need partner legal contact.
Sarah L. (Sales): I have the partner AM on call — @NovaEdge_AM said procurement can email a scanned letter within 2 hours. They also offered to sign a corrected PO if we can provide a blank template now.
Julie O. (Ops): Which marketplace region/portal is this? APAC has slightly different validation rules. If it's APAC East we may need a different ledger mapping.
Maria P.: It's APAC-EAST (apac-east-1). Portal URL: https://marketplace.apac.redwood/portal/orders/98765.
Dan F. (Finance): If the EIN really differs, we need an entity alias sync. I can push a manual override in the ledger but that requires legal approval and a ticket in finance-ops. ETA ~2 hours if docs ready.
Leo K. (Legal): Drafting an affidavit now. Quick question — is Redwood accepting a partner-provided PO with a corrected EIN plus an affidavit referencing the original PO number? If so I'll include language to bind the corrected entity to the order.
Sarah L. (Sales): Yes, NovaEdge can re-upload a corrected PO, but they can't sign it until we confirm the affidavit language. Can Leo share a one-paragraph stub we can send to the partner?
Leo K. (Legal): Stub below — feel free to forward.
```
Affidavit of Signatory Authority
We, NovaEdge Ltd., hereby attest that the individual signing Purchase Order #98765 is authorized to bind NovaEdge Ltd. to the obligations therein. The correct EIN for NovaEdge Ltd. is 88-4445556. This affidavit is provided to permit Redwood Inference to accept the corrected Purchase Order for processing.
```
Sarah L. (Sales): Sending that to the AM now.
marketplace-bot: System: Manual override request queued — ticket #MKP-4521. Approval required from Legal + Finance.
Maria P.: OK process plan: (1) Partner to send scanned signatory letter + re-upload corrected PO with EIN 88-4445556, (2) Leo to finalize affidavit and +1 sign-off, (3) Dan to apply manual ledger alias override once docs in ticket, (4) Julie to retry portal upload and confirm acceptance.
Dan F. (Finance): Confirming I'll be on standby once ticket MKP-4521 has attachments. If we do manual override I'll record audit note and notify accounting.
Julie O. (Ops): Once override applied I can POST the corrected PO via the portal API:
```
POST /api/v1/orders/accept
Header: x-region: apac-east-1
Body: { "po_number": "98765", "e_in": "88-4445556" }
```
Maria P.: Partner just DM'd the signatory letter and re-uploaded the PO. Attaching both to MKP-4521 now.
Leo K. (Legal): I reviewed the scanned letter — good to go. Finalizing affidavit and uploading to the ticket.
marketplace-bot: System: MKP-4521 updated — attachments received. Pending manual approval from both legal and finance.
Dan F. (Finance): Manual override applied, ledger alias created (audit ref FIN-A-901).
Julie O. (Ops): Retried upload, portal returned 200. PO accepted.
Sarah L. (Sales): :tada: Partner confirmed order accepted and shipment window intact. Great cross-team work — Maria/Leo/Dan/Julie thanks!
Maria P.: I'll close the ticket after uploading the affidavit to the partner record and send a short postmortem to Partnerships explaining the mapping fragility and recommended fix.
Leo K. (Legal): I'll add boilerplate affidavit template to the marketplace playbook so we can reuse next time.
Dan F. (Finance): Noted — I'll add an automation request to sync entity aliases nightly to reduce these manual overrides.
Maria P.: Closing thread — marking resolved. :white_check_mark:
